spec.description:
Retrieve a summary of collateral balances, margin position valuations, equity and margin level.

**API Key Permissions Required:** `Orders and trades - Query open orders & trades`

asset.description: Base asset used to determine balance.

rebase_multiplier.description: Optional parameter for viewing xstocks data. `rebased` displays in terms of underlying equity, `base` displays in terms of SPV tokens.

response.title: TradeBalance
response.description: Summary of collateral balances, margin position valuations, equity, and margin level.

eb.description: Equivalent balance (combined balance of all currencies).

tb.description: Trade balance (combined balance of all equity currencies).

n.description: Unrealized net profit/loss of open positions.

v.description: Current floating valuation of open positions.

e.description: Equity: trade balance plus unrealized net profit/loss.

mf.description: Free margin: equity minus initial margin (maximum margin available to open new positions).

mfo.description: Margin free for orders: available margin that can be used for new orders.

ml.description: Margin level: `(equity / initial margin) * 100`. Only present when margin positions are open.

uv.description: Unexecuted value: value of unfilled and partially filled orders.

notes: Upstream's OpenAPI titles this operation's request body 'Update Account Profile Request' -- an evident copy-paste error from an unrelated operation. Retitled to `TradeBalanceRequest` here.
